intro: I’m Tiago Coroado, a dedicated professional with solid experience in technical support and team management within the telecommunications industry. After five years in technical and supervisory roles, I chose to broaden my skill set and have recently completed a technical specialization course in programming. I am now focused on web development, with strong knowledge of JavaScript, PHP, and SQL, as well as solid skills in HTML5, CSS3, and ReactJS. I’m fluent in English, which allows me to work effectively in international environments. This portfolio was built using ReactJS and styled with the DaisyUI component library. The projects showcased here include detailed descriptions in their respective README files. I’m excited to apply my programming and IT knowledge to new professional challenges, whether within or outside my current organization. My goal is to make meaningful contributions to software development projects by combining my technical expertise with proven leadership skills.
